## Choices (2026-10-11)

- `titleUrl` is the dedicated wiki page; `profileUrl` is the Square Enix Wayback page (https://web.archive.org/web/20180911030219/http://www.square-enix.co.jp/magazine/gamebooks/ff/7_turks_tkaa/index.html); the recap is the wiki's `#Story` and the fan translation its `#External_links` (the Lifestream part-1 post it replaced is one of the translations listed there)
- No release-order suffix: it shares December 15, 2011 with Fragments Before and the XIII-2 game, but those are in other series, and a suffix is only needed for same-series conflicts
- Description: a short intro, not a summary
